title: A stack class and a counter closure
hints: In the error class: constructor() { super("the stack is empty"); this.name = "EmptyStackError"; }
A private field is declared at the top of the class: #items = []; and used as this.#items.
get size() { return this.#items.length; } defines the getter.
counter: let count = start; then return an object whose three functions use and change count.
